component: Play setup: one heading per setting (U7)
explanation: Each setup setting got its own section heading and container; a setting is a small label, its control and spacing (SetupField). Excessive section headings and containers. Evidence: CaissaTrainer docs/ui/figma-revamp/after/computer-setup-1440.png, an earlier iteration of the Play setup page that still shows the problem (Level 4 repeated over the preview, Opponent and You seats before the colour is decided, each setting with its own heading). The rule text is CaissaTrainer doctrine U3, U7, U28, U29 and U30 (docs/ui/doctrine.md section 3.1). Recorded by an agent; the classification is a suggestion for the owner.
